summary: make the web console and the eight planned contracts consistent with the research-universe, numeraire and model-boundary decisions
owner_direction:
Owner direction for the A0003 SPEC amendment (2026-09-19).

CONTEXT. The Intent layer already carries the research-universe, numeraire-hierarchy
and model-boundary decisions: PROJECT_GOALS.md sections 4, 5 and 8, and goals
G-RESEARCH-UNIVERSE-01, G-NUMERAIRE-02, G-DATASET-01 and G-ML-01. ADR-014 and ADR-015
are accepted, LP_METRICS.md and research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md exist, and
PROVIDER_FACTS.md carries the per-pool window rule. This amendment makes the
specification and the still-PLANNED contracts consistent with those. Do not edit
docs/intent/, and do not reopen or rewrite an accepted ADR: cite them instead.

1. docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md
 (a) Add WEB-PAGE-008 (data coverage and downloads), WEB-PAGE-009 (replay and position
     inspector), WEB-PAGE-010 (dataset builder) and WEB-PAGE-011 (model laboratory).
     Each must state what it shows and must state explicitly that it is owned by T103
     and lies outside T084's acceptance.
 (b) Extend the results view requirement so that performance is broken down by market
     regime and time slice, each slice reporting the number of independent episodes
     behind it and an uncertainty interval rather than a bare point estimate.
 (c) Extend WEB-GLOBAL-001 so every page shows the active dataset version and the
     reporting numeraire, and so a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset is visibly distinguishable
     from a USD-denominated one.
 (d) Extend section 4 (visualisation minimum) to cover coverage maps, replay
     timelines, dataset and label provenance, and model diagnostics.
 (e) Do not change section 5 and do not remove or weaken any existing page or clause.

2. Eight contract edits. Each target contract keeps its identity, status, attempt and
   dependency fields; only the body text changes. Every added quantity must state its
   units and availability time, and no existing acceptance clause may be weakened.
 - T053: generalise from a USDG-only quote source to the ADR-014 numeraire hierarchy
   (USDG first, then a qualified USD stablecoin, with ETH display-only), keeping USDG
   mandatory for the active execution pool and for both 5-minute rules. Add
   RELATIVE_ONLY datasets, which must carry no USD-denominated field anywhere. The
   per-numeraire availability-time, provenance and staleness semantics are unchanged
   and must still hold for whichever numeraire is selected.
 - T052: require every rebalancing-loss figure to be labelled a proxy with its
   declared reference (LP_METRICS M-LVR-001); add breakeven volatility (M-BE-001)
   computed from the replay's own fee and rebalancing series; and require attribution
   for a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset to remain relative.
 - T049: state explicitly that the sizing mathematics is numeraire-independent, that
   the integer and liquidityDelta discipline is unchanged, and that the numeraire
   applies only to the capital envelope and its reporting.
 - T063: the manifest must also record the dataset version and the reporting
   numeraire, in addition to everything it records today.
 - T064: add pool holdout as the primary generalisation test, and purge/embargo whose
   length is derived from the label horizon, alongside the existing walk-forward,
   holdout and parameter-surface requirements.
 - T084: narrow its acceptance to the WEB-GLOBAL-*, read-only WEB-PAGE-* and
   visualisation requirements owned by T083 through T086, and state that the four
   pages owned by T103 are outside its acceptance. Without this clause the task can
   never pass once those pages exist in the specification.
 - T085: dataset and model definitions are versioned through this task's write path
   but must never become an execution approval, appear as one, or be reachable from an
   execution-shaped control.
 - T050: name the ownership boundary explicitly - time/block bars and market features
   belong to T050, the research panel labels belong to T101 - so that the same
   quantity is not implemented twice.

3. Raise spec_revision.

4. CONSTRAINTS. Change only docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, the eight named
   contracts, and spec_revision. Do not edit docs/intent/. Do not edit any other
   contract. Do not change any task status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA,
   review record, approval datum or the agent runtime. Do not cite the superseded
   T022, T023 or T038 as live governing contracts. No credential-bearing URL, API
   key, authorization header or environment value may be written into any file.
